messages:
elaine: FYI CI is red on image publish for release/1.8 — push step fails with HTTP 413 Request Entity Too Large. cc @sam @maria

buildbot: upload logs: 
```
Step 1/10 : FROM node:18-alpine
 ---> 123abc
... compressing layer 5/5
Pushing to registry.redwood-internal.com/redwood/app:release-1.8
error: failed to push to registry: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = received unexpected HTTP status: 413 Request Entity Too Large
blob upload canceled
```

sam: ouch. 413 usually means our registry or proxy is rejecting the payload size. did anything change in Dockerfile or .dockerignore?

elaine: I only landed a tiny change to the Dockerfile to add a build arg, but i DID fiddle with .dockerignore earlier in the sprint — maybe i accidentally removed an exclude. can't repro locally yet, trying a rerun.

maria: quick check — can you show the build context size? `du -sh .` from repo root before build. if node_modules or dist got into context that would bloat the tar.

elaine: running locally: 
```
$ du -sh .
1.6G	.
```
uh. that's huge. we usually see ~30M.

jon: that confirms it. probable cause: dotfiles or build artifacts are getting included. @elaine can you paste `.dockerignore`?

elaine: current `.dockerignore`:
```
.git
.vscode
Dockerfile.dev
# build artifacts
# (accidentally deleted the excludes here last week)
```

sam: yep — looks like the lines excluding `/dist` and `/node_modules` are missing. if the CI builder packs the whole 1.6G context the push will create very large layers and the registry (nginx proxy) will hit its client_max_body_size or S3 chunk limits.

maria: quick mitigation: two options — 1) restore the excludes in `.dockerignore` and re-run pipeline, or 2) switch to a multistage build that produces a small final image and only copies artifacts from the builder stage (already mostly in place, but context still matters).

jon: i can bisect the commits on release/1.8 to find when the dockerignore lost the lines. give me 10m.

(buildbot): bisect job started by jon — https://ci.redwood.dev/job/bisect/2345

jon: found it — commit `c4f2a9d` from last week removed the excludes during a merge conflict. i pushed a revert to restore the .dockerignore lines. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/app/pull/4781

elaine: thanks. i've kicked off a patch pipeline with the reverted `.dockerignore`.

(buildbot): pipeline build/5182 (patch) started — pushing image...

buildbot: pipeline update — push step succeeded. image published to registry.redwood-internal.com/redwood/app:release-1.8-patch-1 :tada:

elaine: green now, thanks everyone. i'll follow up with a small pre-commit hook to check context size and add a note to the PR template about `.dockerignore` sanity. :memo:

sam: can we also add a CI check that prints the build context size and fails if >200M? would avoid surprises.

maria: +1 — filing a tiny infra task.

elaine: closing the thread. :)
